messages.denied: The reader takes your credentials, considers them, and declines to elaborate.
messages.hackFail: The mantrap lock rejects the sequence and logs the attempt somewhere you cannot reach.
messages.hackSuccess: The mantrap lock drops its challenge and the outer slab breathes open.
messages.lock: The mantrap door seats itself with a pneumatic thump.
messages.unlock: The mantrap door unseals, one bolt at a time, in no hurry at all.
